biography:
I'm finding, addressing, and delivering the right solution to challenges that IT Professionals (in every size organization) are facing everyday - Digital Transformation/Customer Experience/Big Data Analysis/Staying Ahead of the Competition/Reducing Complexity/Optimizing Workflows/Being Agile/Limited Resources & Budgets (and more).  

My focus is helping  organizations re-imagine their core IT infrastructure by utilizing an array of different “hybrid” approaches that meet their drive to maximize IT agility so they can support new business needs (e.g. digital customer experience; big data analysis) while holding down the cost.  This re-imagining enables them to focus more of their resources on delivering business applications — not managing data centers and day-to-day IT infrastructure updates.

QTS is the hybrid service provider and cloud operator organizations choose to deliver the right solutions needed to solve their business problems by offering: Colocation + Cloud (Private + Public), Dedicated + Multi-tenant, Self + Managed Services with a strategic focus in Security and Compliance tailored for the individual needs of any size organization (We are built for Large-Scale Cloud/Hosting Infrastructure).  

It's exciting to work for such a great company where we rely on our people first to provide expertise, technology and infrastructure to all IT decision makers helping them manage and protect their critical data especially during a time of unprecedented change.  Because of our approach, customers rate QTS very highly with a recently reported NPS Score of 68% putting QTS ahead of any other data center provider in this industry. 

I look forward to helping your organization succeed also, please reach out to me anytime!
